caption: The drawing depicts a centrally placed rectangular object with slightly rounded corners, resembling a piece of embroidery or needlework, on an off-white or beige background. The rectangular design is composed of a geometric, symmetrical pattern that features a large blue starburst or floral motif occupying most of the central area. The starburst pattern radiates outward from the center with angular, leaf-like elements. The background of the embroidery is a light tan or beige color, contrasting with the blue pattern. The outer edge of the rectangle is bordered with a dark green outline, which also includes small green corner accents, creating a frame-like effect around the central motif. The drawing contains no additional objects or elements apart from the embroidered motif and the off-white surrounding area. There is a small signature or text to the lower right of the rectangle.
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
